mentions.name: PGlite
mentions.description: PGlite is Postgres compiled to WebAssembly (wasm), allowing the Postgres database to run in the browser or other wasm environments. Upcoming work in the pipeline includes multi-connection support, a native library, and extensions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
PGlite - Postgres in wasm

Loads of useful things in the pipeline: multi connection support, native library, extensions and many more ideas.
